# Constructed inverse lowering study

This informed bounded source was prepared before checking and before the finite
lowering change. Existing shared syntax, concrete selected support and Reference
were known. The first source and actual finite refusal are retained unchanged.
The desired inverse of (HZ)^2 has the independent exact matrix
[[0,1],[-1,0]] in column-vector convention; it sends |0> to -|1>.
Measurement alone cannot validate that sign or arbitrary reference behavior.
No generic QFT, capacity expansion, new interpretation or guarantee is proposed.
